record.title: Pressure-test a remote ledger kernel
record.intent: After the checkpoint, implement the bounded Postgres/HTTP ledger kernel against the same domain: CAS, revisions, currency, receipts, planning and lifecycle events.
requirements: After the checkpoint, implement the bounded Postgres/HTTP ledger kernel against the same domain: CAS, revisions, currency, receipts, planning and lifecycle events.

Implement only after typed evidence time and planning history. Initially use the minimal profile and strict whole-ledger CAS; measure unrelated-writer contention without silently reinterpreting Revision. No deployment or background service operation is included.
acceptance: File and remote ledger conformance agree; no SaaS, tenancy, billing, RBAC or product UI.
